prompt_en:
Create a vertical 4:5 full-length environmental fashion photograph on the open stern vehicle deck of a working car ferry underway before sunrise. Show one adult woman with long dark near-black hair in loose waves, a near-center part, restrained natural makeup, a composed closed-mouth expression, and a calm direct gaze. Use the supplied portrait solely as guidance for visible adult appearance cues, rendering an original adult subject. Place her left of center with clear fog-backed space to frame right, keeping her complete head, both feet, both garment anchors, and both flying hems inside the image.

She is caught midway through a controlled pivot: left foot planted on the diagonal yellow lane stripe, right foot crossing forward, torso rotating toward the lens, left hand securing cloth at her waist, and right arm separated slightly from her silhouette. Dress her in a deep copper-red silk-satin mantle gown with a sleeveless bias-cut column base, an asymmetric drape fastened at the left shoulder, a visible waist gather, and two long free panels. A steady sea crosswind travels from frame left to frame right. The shoulder panel rises into a broad high S-curve; the waist panel sweeps lower across her calves and curls once near its hem. Continuous tension connects both panels to their visible anchors, diagonal pull lines join hip and stepping knee, and her lower hair lengths and the thin sea fog stream frame right.

Across the gown, one continuous satin-like garment surface remains traceable from the shoulder clasp to both flying hems. From those load points, fold ridges and curvature define a coherent drape direction from the left shoulder and waist anchors. Under a long cool-white work light set low and far camera-left, a broad smooth highlight follows those folds along the copper-red ridges; material detail remains visible through the darker planes between adjacent luminous ridges; seams and garment edges preserve surface ownership across both moving panels. Broad cloth planes rolling away from the light remain softly copper-red and oxblood, while a small amber navigation lamp behind camera-right adds a restrained edge accent. Dim navy predawn skylight keeps her face naturally readable and the steel shadows detailed.

Photograph from a low three-quarter viewpoint slightly camera-left at knee height, about 4.5 meters away with a 35 mm full-frame lens, approximately f/4, 1/800 second, ISO 800. Freeze the face, body, main fold ridges, anchors, and shoes sharply, with a slight directional blur confined to the last few centimeters of each hem. Keep the damp blue-gray deck, muted red ribs, safety rail, secured chain coils, and stern fog legible, with the yellow stripe as the single strong counterpoint to the copper-red gown and cool steel. Finish as a cinematic on-location fashion editorial with fine realistic grain, natural skin texture, crisp cloth micro-contrast, controlled highlights, deep detailed shadows, and physically coherent damp-deck reflections.
negative_en: excessive HDR, over-processed retouching, cartoon style, illustration look, low resolution, unrealistic hands, fake-looking background

preserved_evidence: open stern vehicle deck of a working car ferry underway before sunrise
one adult woman with long dark near-black hair in loose waves

authorial_decisions.decision: Reserve clear fog-backed space at frame right around both airborne panels.
authorial_decisions.rationale: The uncluttered silhouette makes the two anchored motion paths readable at thumbnail scale.

authorial_decisions.decision: Use the yellow lane stripe as the single strong counterpoint to copper-red and blue-gray.
authorial_decisions.rationale: The restrained accent supports depth and foot placement while leaving fold luminance dominant.
